querystring.select: SELECT B.VENDOR_NAME AS AssetHo, A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID AS VendorParentId
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR A WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.VENDOR B WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID = B.VENDOR_ID
querystring.where: WHERE MR_VENDOR_CLASS = 'BRANCH' AND MR_VENDOR_CATEGORY_CODE = 'ASSET_INSCO_BRANCH' AND VENDOR_ID = {0}
